# Twine

> Twine is an open-source tool for creating interactive fiction and non-linear narratives through a visual editor and web-based platform.

Twine enables authors to craft branching stories, games, and interactive experiences without requiring programming knowledge. The platform supports multiple story formats, export options to EPUB and other formats, and has an active community contributing recipes, examples, and documentation.

## Key Topics

- Interactive fiction
- Story creation
- Twine editor
- HTML/CSS customization
- Cookbook recipes
- Browser-based editor
- Desktop application
- EPUB export
- Accessibility compliance
- WCAG standards
- Community contributions
- Code of Conduct

## Getting Started & Documentation

- [Twine Cookbook](https://twinery.org/cookbook): Recipes, examples, and tips for creating interactive fiction with Twine
